decisions: The Human PI-designated D:/项目仓库/赛博课题组 path is the canonical repository; the former path is compatibility-only.
Conversation history is an execution cache, not project memory. Project-owned checkpoint, decisions and evidence references are the durable resume surface.
Rollover occurs when expected marginal information value is lower than marginal context cost or reliability risk; token count is a signal but not the sole rule.
Rollover must write back all material state first, verify a file-only successor resume, repoint rather than duplicate an existing schedule, and archive rather than delete the predecessor.
DeepSeek-native independence is an acceptance property of the harness, while GPT/OpenAI integration stays optional and separately governed; no GPT model-routing policy change was authorized or made.

Two defects adjacent to the DSH review were reported rather than repaired: the Claude Code settings.json literal %PATH% defect lies outside DSH scope and has machine-wide blast radius, and disabling the lab-headless projection cache without failure evidence would be speculative.
